We need to compare two questions.

Q1: "A Convenção Interamericana sobre a Proteção dos Direitos Humanos dos Idosos deve ser ratificada?" This asks about ratification of the Inter-American Convention on the Protection of the Human Rights of Older Persons.

Q2: "A convenção sobre os direitos da pessoa idosa deve ser aprovada na Câmara dos Deputados?" This asks about approval in the Chamber of Deputies (Brazilian lower house) of "the convention on the rights of the elderly person". Could refer to same convention? The Inter-American Convention would need ratification by Brazil, which involves approval by Congress (both houses) and then presidential ratification. The question 2 mentions approval in the Chamber of Deputies specifically. So they are related but not identical: one asks about ratification (overall process), the other about approval in the Chamber. Also "convenção sobre os direitos da pessoa idosa" could be generic, maybe same convention. But the scope differs: ratification vs legislative approval in one house. Also polarity same (both ask "should be ..."). Not opposite. Are they equivalent? Not exactly, because ratification includes more steps. So they are DIFFERENT issues (different procedural step). Could be UNCERTAIN if ambiguous whether they refer to same convention. But likely they refer to same convention (the Inter-American). However the question is about different actions: ratify vs approve in Chamber. So answer DIFFERENT.

Thus JSON with relation DIFFERENT and reasoning.
